note: Retrieval questions over the MAS corpus, each with every passage that answers it (hit@3 counts the first relevant passage among the three a search hands the agent). Categories: 'paraphrase' and 'terms' are the first 32, written in 2026-10 after reading the passages by the person who built the chunker; 'agent-query' are queries the investigator and the case assistant actually sent (golden and conversation evaluations, verbatim); 'definition', 'cross-reference' (the answer names its subject only through 'paragraphs 6, 7 or 8'), 'near-miss' (a neighbouring passage answers a slightly different question), 'coverage' (topics the first 32 never touched) and 'case' (an investigator's question with the case facts) were added 2026-10-28 (ADR 0030). Labels of the added questions were pooled: every passage any mode ranked in its top three was judged against the PDF text, and those that answer the question were added; LLM rerank output was never used as a label. A second annotator (another model, blind to the first's notes) then judged every label of the added questions; its changes were adopted where the passage text bore them out, and three ambiguous questions were reworded. Not yet reviewed by a person. Split: the first 32 are 'dev' (every past decision was made on them); the added ones were split per category by a hash of the question, about 55% 'test'. Tune on dev; run test once to confirm a decision.
